MsgraphMailFolder.description:
A mail folder in a user's mailbox. Doubles as the create body, where
only `display_name` (and optionally `is_hidden`) is serialized.

childFolderCount.description: The number of immediate child folders.

displayName.description: The display name of the folder.

id.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

isHidden.description: Whether the folder is hidden from folder listings.

parentFolderId.description: The identifier of the parent folder.

sizeInBytes.description: The size of the folder in bytes.

totalItemCount.description: The total number of items in the folder.

unreadItemCount.description: The number of unread items in the folder.

description: Renderable table of Microsoft Graph mail folders.
title: MailFoldersTable
